title: onlycraft
description: A very vanilla like modpack with some basic mods for a server with your friends! Survive, Explore and Craft!
body:
# onlycraft
A very vanilla server project for friends - Survive, Explore and most importantly Craft. **Build anything which comes to your imagination!**

## modpack content
The modpack only includes client-side mods which will improve your gaming experience. All of this mods are really vanilla like and will help you with your exploring and building - Like e.g. better views with the help of fullbright and freecam, easy talking with friends via in-game voice chat, but also things like an in-game map.

## modpack usage
The modpack can be used directly as it is or can be adjusted (Like removing mods or adding some other _allowed_ mods/rp/shaders). If you want to change it, you can download a version of this modpack (.mrpack) and create a new instance inside of modrinth.
